summary: The trace reveals a distinct home infusion delivery batching analysis pattern that differs fundamentally from the existing cycle-margin-analysis skill: per-therapy patient counts from revision-controlled overrides, dose-mg-per-day drug costing, per-patient delivery payments, alias-based entity matching, and different decision logic. The agent failed, likely due to wrong patient count selection (not using highest approved revision) and possibly inverted decision logic. This patch creates a new skill capturing the correct workflow and updates the existing skill to cross-reference it.
